text: @yunlai/dsh-workbench 是 DeepSeek Harness 的网页端开发工作台，在右侧面板整合源码与文档阅读、Git 变更检查和程序调试。它通过工作区文件树、内容搜索和定义跳转帮助定位代码，也可预览 Markdown 与图片、查看差异和提交历史、设置断点并检查暂停时的变量。用户还能把选中的变更发送到新会话，或让会话解释代码并整理成项目记忆卡片。适合在 Harness 对话旁阅读和核对项目代码；使用调试功能需配置本地适配器，Go 和 Java 语言服务也需另行设置。

@yunlai/dsh-workbench adds a web workbench to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar. Browse and search files, jump to definitions, preview documents, review Git changes, and debug local programs. Send changes to a new conversation or save explanations as memory cards. Debugging needs a local adapter.
想在和 DSH 对话时同时浏览项目源码和文件。
如何快速搜索工作区里的某段代码并跳到匹配位置？
我想从函数调用处直接跳到定义。
能不能在 Harness 里查看 Git 改动和提交历史？
我需要在代码上打断点并调试本地程序。
想把 Markdown 文档和图片直接在工作台里预览。
希望把选中的代码改动发给新的对话做解释或处理。
I want to browse a project and keep my Harness conversation visible.
Can I search workspace files and jump to symbol definitions?
I need to inspect Git diffs and debug a local program from the sidebar.
工作区内容搜索：在当前项目或指定目录中查找字面文本，支持大小写选项并返回文件、行号和匹配片段；点选结果可回到对应源码位置。
Git 变更与历史：工作台列出暂存、未暂存和未跟踪文件的差异，也展示提交图、提交详情；可从差异行打开源码或把选中改动交给新对话。
断点调试：通过已配置的适配器启动或接入本地程序，在源码设置断点，并查看暂停帧、作用域和变量。
解释与记忆卡片：从工作区代码发起解释对话，并在工作台按目录查看、搜索项目中的 Markdown 卡片。
Python 类关系：解析项目中的 Python 源码，呈现类、继承和工厂返回关系，便于从关系图回到相关声明。
调试功能会在本地启动或接入目标程序，并可在暂停时读取变量；使用前需按语言配置相应调试适配器。

AI 改完代码后，先在右侧打开 diff，从改动行跳回源码，再沿定义读到实现。遇到需要弄懂的代码，可以把问题交给一个讲解会话，随后在工作台翻阅卡片。文件树、编辑器和底部工具窗口可以调整大小，当前对话始终留在旁边。

@yunlai/dsh-workbench README · 快速开始：1. 在 DeepSeek Harness 的插件管理器选择「安装插件」，输入 `@yunlai/dsh-workbench`，启用「开发工作台」。
2. 打开一个已注册的 Git 项目对话，展开右侧工具区，在「开始」或「更多工具」中选择「开发工作台」。
3. 从文件树打开文件。在支持的源码中按 `F12` 跳定义，或从底部打开「变更」核对 diff。

在线安装用户可在插件详情检查版本并更新，随后重载或重启 Harness。当前发布包要求 Harness `0.2.1-rc.5` 或更新版本，运行环境要求 Node.js `22.14.0` 或更新版本。[下载 ZIP](https://github.com/Chengyunlai/dsh-workbench/releases/latest) · [升级说明](UPGRADING.md)

@yunlai/dsh-workbench README · 快速开始：下载 Release 中的 ZIP 并解压，按包内 `INSTALL.txt` 安装依赖，再在 Harness 插件管理器中选择解压后的目录。也可以克隆仓库并安装源码目录。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Chengyunlai/dsh-workbench.git
cd dsh-workbench
npm ci --omit=dev
```

</details>

@yunlai/dsh-workbench README · 工作台能做什么：| 想做的事 | 在工作台里怎么做 |
| --- | --- |
| **读懂源码** | 用文件树和内容查找定位代码。标签保留各文件的阅读位置，支持语法高亮、折叠、同词高亮、定义跳转和前进／后退。右键标签可关闭当前、其他或全部文件。 |
| **看清 Python 类关系** | 从文件树工具栏或 Python 源码右键菜单打开层级树或分栏图。查看继承、抽象类、显式 Protocol 基类及有源码依据的工厂返回关联，点击节点或方法跳回源码。类关系目前仅支持 Python，处于 Beta 阶段。 |
| **阅读文档和图片** | 对话中的 Markdown 可进入工作台预览，也可切回源码。预览支持 YAML 标题、标签和字段、代码块高亮与文件链接。文件标签还可预览 PNG、SVG、ICNS 等图片和图标。 |
| **核对 Git 改动** | 分组查看已暂存、工作区变更和未跟踪文件，阅读逐行 diff、提交图与提交详情。双击 diff 行可跳到当前源码。可把选中的 diff 行作为修改任务或讲解材料交给新会话。 |
| **检查真实执行** | 启动调试或接入已有进程，设置断点、单步并切换栈帧。暂停时可悬浮查看变量、展开对象、查看行内值及求值，也可一次清理全部断点。 |
| **运行项目命令** | 从底部打开终端，复用 Harness 终端服务在当前会话的工作区运行命令。切换到查找、变更、历史、记忆卡片或调试时，编辑区仍可见。 |
@yunlai/dsh-workbench README · 工作台能做什么：Python 类图基于静态源码分析。定义跳转可打开语言服务返回的受支持库源码和声明文件，显示为只读库标签。[类关系说明](USAGE.md#python-类关系图) · [导航限制](USAGE.md#导航行为与限制)

@yunlai/dsh-workbench README · 讲给我听与记忆卡片：例如读到一个 `stream()` 方法，想知道 SSE 字节在哪里分帧、何时变成模型事件。右键文件选「讲给我听」，输入问题。新会话会尝试沿源码和具体输入讲清链路，把同一份完整解释保存成一张卡。卡片先概括问题，末尾用一道回忆题请你复述机制或预测边界情况。

底部「记忆卡片」按归档目录分组，可组合搜索标题、摘要、标签、来源与路径。卡片是项目中的 Markdown 文件，默认存放在 `.dsh/cards/`。关联文件的卡片按源码最近两级目录归档，未关联源码的归入 `general/`，已有卡片也可按来源在索引里归组。[卡片使用指南](USAGE.md#记忆卡片)

@yunlai/dsh-workbench README · 语言支持：下表区分定义跳转与调试。五种语言都可只读浏览、语法高亮和折叠。Go 和 Java 需要配置本机语言服务，Python 和 JS／TS 的导航依赖随包安装。

| 语言 | 定义跳转 | 启动与接入调试 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Python | Pyright | debugpy |
| Go | gopls | Delve |
| Java | Eclipse JDT LS | 暂无 |
| JavaScript | TypeScript 语言服务 | vscode-js-debug（Node.js） |
| TypeScript | TypeScript 语言服务 | vscode-js-debug（需要生成 JS 和 source map） |

调试适配器需单独配置。配置好后可在源码区设置断点并按 `F5`，或用右键菜单接入已有进程。自定义启动参数可写入 `.dsh/debug.json`。[语言配置](USAGE.md#五种语言的支持与配置) · [调试配置](DEBUGGING.md#安装调试器)

@yunlai/dsh-workbench README · Introduction：After the agent changes code, open the diff on the right, jump from a changed line to the source, and follow definitions to the implementation. Send a question to an explanation conversation when you want to understand a piece of code, then revisit its card in the workbench. Resize the file tree, editor, and bottom tool window while keeping your conversation in view.

@yunlai/dsh-workbench README · Quick start：Extract the ZIP from the release, install dependencies as described in `INSTALL.txt`, and select the extracted directory in the Harness plugin manager. You can also clone and install the source directory.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Chengyunlai/dsh-workbench.git
cd dsh-workbench
npm ci --omit=dev
```

</details>

@yunlai/dsh-workbench README · What the workbench does：| Task | How to do it in the workbench |
| --- | --- |
| **Read source** | Find code with the file tree and content search. Tabs retain reading positions and support highlighting, folding, occurrence highlighting, definitions, and Back/Forward. Right-click a tab to close it, the other tabs, or all tabs. |
| **Explore Python class relationships** | Open a hierarchy tree or docked diagram from the file-tree toolbar or Python source menu. Inspect inheritance, abstract classes, declared Protocol bases, and factory return associations grounded in source. Open source from class and method nodes. Class relationships are currently Python-only and in beta. |
| **Read documents and images** | Open Markdown from a conversation in a reading preview or switch to source. The preview shows YAML titles, tags, and fields, highlighted code blocks, and file links. Tabs also preview images and icons such as PNG, SVG, and ICNS. |
| **Review Git changes** | Browse staged, working-tree, and untracked changes, line diffs, commit graphs, and commit details. Double-click a diff line to open current source. Send selected diff lines to a new conversation

@yunlai/dsh-workbench README · What the workbench does：Python diagrams use static source analysis. Definition results can open supported library sources and declaration files in read-only library tabs. [Class relationships](USAGE.en.md#python-class-relationships) · [Navigation limits](USAGE.en.md#navigation-behavior-and-limits)

@yunlai/dsh-workbench README · Explanations and memory cards：Suppose you are reading a `stream()` method and want to know where SSE bytes become frames and then model events. Right-click the file, select Explain it to me, and enter the question. The new conversation is prompted to trace the source with a concrete input and save the full explanation in one card. The card opens with a question recap and ends with a prompt to recall the mechanism or predict an edge case.

@yunlai/dsh-workbench README · Explanations and memory cards：The Memory cards tool groups cards by archive folder and searches titles, summaries, tags, sources, and paths in combination. Cards are Markdown files in the project and default to `.dsh/cards/`. Linked cards use the nearest two source directories, questions without linked source go under `general/`, and existing cards can be grouped in the index by their source metadata. [Memory cards guide](USAGE.en.md#memory-cards)

text: @yunlai/dsh-workbench README · Language support：The table separates definition navigation from debugging. All five languages support read-only browsing, syntax highlighting, and folding. Go and Java require local language-server setup. Python and JS/TS navigation dependencies ship with the package.

@yunlai/dsh-workbench README · Language support：| Language | Definitions | Launch and attach |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Python | Pyright | debugpy |
| Go | gopls | Delve |
| Java | Eclipse JDT LS | Unavailable |
| JavaScript | TypeScript language service | vscode-js-debug (Node.js) |
| TypeScript | TypeScript language service | vscode-js-debug (requires emitted JS and source maps) |

@yunlai/dsh-workbench README · Language support：Configure a debug adapter separately. Then set a breakpoint and press `F5` in source, or attach through the context menu. For custom launch arguments, use `.dsh/debug.json`. [Language setup](USAGE.en.md#five-language-support-and-configuration) · [Debug setup](DEBUGGING.en.md#adapters)
